mechanisms.name: Static CMS story template
mechanisms.evidence: No client-side state: a hero grid (name, category chip, logo, summary, back link, cover image) plus one prose body, server-rendered by the original Astro app

mechanisms.name: Category chip colour
mechanisms.evidence: inline background-color on the chip (per-category), not a class

mechanisms.name: Button icon roll on hover
mechanisms.evidence: group/button translate-x custom properties on the back link, 300ms CSS transition
